latest_release.name: "Justicia" Hotfix 1 release
latest_release.body:
- Added a custom Vulkan driver loader (only available in github release and debug builds)
- Fixed issues with file renaming during download
- Removed bytehook
- Moved chmod/fchmod fixes from launcher-side hooks to JRE patches
- Fixed NoBlocklist on Java 8
- Fixed hanging when downloading Cleanroom jsons
- Fixed weirdness with physical mouse when opening launcher menus ingame
- Added checks to avoid crashing the game when ely.by is not available
- Updated Authlib-Injector to 1.2.8 for 26.3 compatibility
